symbol_mismatch.installed_help_excerpt:
--rename-kernels arg (=1)             Perform simplification on the kernel demangled names.
                                        Rename demangled names using a config file. By default, searches for 
                                        ncu-kernel-renames.yaml config file in the current working directory and 
                                        "$HOME/.config/NVIDIA Corporation" directory. Use --rename-kernels-export

symbol_mismatch.inference: The saved help explicitly describes simplification of demangled names. This is consistent with the lossy NCU name, but does not prove exact eager/graph kernel or scheduling equivalence. No namespace/boolean/type rewriting was used to change the declared gate.

conditional_hypothesis.scope: The single instrumented eager FA3 launch only; pending graph identity/scheduling confirmation
conditional_hypothesis.lead: Exposed memory-dependency latency with low active-warp residency is a plausible next hypothesis to test.
support: Measured active warps are 12.49% of peak sustained active.
DRAM throughput is 36.77% of the reported peak sustained elapsed denominator; tensor active cycles are 11.47% of that metric denominator.
limits: Long scoreboard is a dependency-stall statistic; 43.40% is not the fraction of whole-call wall time, and does not identify HBM versus cache/page-address dependence.
Tensor active-cycle percentage is not achieved FLOP percentage.
Moderate DRAM throughput does not prove bandwidth saturation or rule out memory latency.
Low measured active-warps does not establish that register count is the cause; persistent scheduling, producer/consumer roles, barriers and other limits remain possible.
No exact CTA-residency trace, stall source attribution or causal intervention was measured.
The strict graph/eager symbol gate failed and the bottleneck interpretation for the timed graph remains inconclusive.

next_discriminating_measurement.first: Verify the full unrenamed eager symbol with the installed-help-supported --rename-kernels 0, preserving the same selected source, input bytes, filter, launch geometry and correctness gates. This option was not executed in this run.
next_discriminating_measurement.second: Compare resolved scheduler/partial-allocation and launch-dependency state between graph and eager calls using supported auxiliary/schema evidence; names and grid alone cannot prove automatic split/PDL equivalence.
next_discriminating_measurement.then_if_identity_is_established: Distinguish latency/address-dependency exposure from bandwidth pressure with a small separately justified memory/cache/dependency measurement. Do not change algorithm, splits or register targets from these four counters alone.
